notes.title: Demo updated!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We have updated the free demo of Sunday Run today with 2 new levels. They are on the normal side, so not super difficult to get through. Hopefully you'll have fun trying to get all the medals still!

We also added re-bindable keys to the settings menu. Feel free to put that reset button further away to prevent accidental resets :D

And thanks to everyone who has tried the demo so far. Please join our discord and share your times, videos and feedback with us!
